## 📦 Download Nostr events

Paste your **API token** in the *API token* field (top bar), then click a link. Each download is filtered by **event time** (`created_at`) and streamed on demand from ClickHouse.

- **JSONL**: one JSON event per line (`id, pubkey, created_at, kind, tags, content, sig`).
- **Parquet**: columnar, best for analytics.

| Range | JSONL | Parquet |
|---|---|---|
| **Today** | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=today&format=jsonl&token=${token}) | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=today&format=parquet&token=${token}) |
| **This week** | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=this_week&format=jsonl&token=${token}) | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=this_week&format=parquet&token=${token}) |
| **This month** | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=this_month&format=jsonl&token=${token}) | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=this_month&format=parquet&token=${token}) |
| **Last month** | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=last_month&format=jsonl&token=${token}) | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=last_month&format=parquet&token=${token}) |
| **Last 3 months** | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=last_3_months&format=jsonl&token=${token}) | [⬇️ download](/api/v1/export?range=last_3_months&format=parquet&token=${token}) |

> Large ranges (3 months) may take a while; the download is written as a stream. For recurring bulk dumps, the full notepack segments live in the Garage `pensieve-archive` bucket.
